response.original_text:
Sen. Robin Padilla said the South Cotabato school incident has strengthened his decision to leave politics, expressing frustration over Congress’ continued refusal to amend the Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act.
“Hindi naman ako bulag at bingi,” Padilla said.
Padilla earlier announced that he would no longer seek elective office in the next elections.
#dailytribune #RobinPadilla
